calls.note: Hooks the scene calculation's interval update: store the measured frame ratio, clamped from 20 to 300 fps, then run the original update and its side effects.
Hooks the second interval-update call the same way: store the measured frame ratio, clamped from 20 to 300 fps, then run the original update and its side effects.

words.note: Omits the virtual-pool flag in the graphics allocator constructor. Armigo's NVN driver implements ordinary pools, with the GPU address equal to the guest address.
Lowers the dynamic present-interval candidate floor from 2.0 to 1.0, so a frame that fits one refresh can present at 60 fps instead of waiting for two.
Lowers the dynamic present-interval floor check from 2 to 1, so the framework can select one refresh instead of holding a 30 fps floor.
Lowers the step-down target recorded when the present interval steps up, from 3 to 2, so it matches the new floor of one refresh.
Lowers the step-down target compared when the present interval steps up, from 3 to 2, so recovery matches the new floor of one refresh.
Stops stepping the present interval down once it is below 2 rather than below 3, so the floor stays at one refresh.
Replaces the job queue's thread-context lock acquire with one atomic swap. Workers retake the lock without pausing and starve the main thread, causing 80-170 ms hitches.
On a failed swap, returns to the plain-load spin of the thread-context job-queue acquire. The exclusive loop livelocked under host scheduling and caused 80-170 ms hitches.
After a successful atomic swap, continues past the thread-context job-queue acquire. The exclusive spin livelocked under host scheduling and caused 80-170 ms hitches.
Removes the back edge of the thread-context job-queue spin. The exclusive acquire livelocked under host scheduling and caused 80-170 ms hitches.
Removes the thread-context job-queue acquire's exclusive store; the atomic swap already claimed the lock. The spin caused 80-170 ms hitches.
Removes the thread-context job-queue exclusive-store retry. The acquire is one atomic swap; the old spin caused 80-170 ms hitches under host scheduling.
Replaces the job queue's other lock acquire with one atomic swap. Workers retake the lock without pausing and starve the main thread, causing 80-170 ms hitches.
On a failed swap, returns to the plain-load spin of the job queue's other acquire. The exclusive loop livelocked under host scheduling and caused 80-170 ms hitches.
After a successful atomic swap, continues past the job queue's other acquire. The exclusive spin livelocked under host scheduling and caused 80-170 ms hitches.
Removes the back edge of the job queue's other spin. The exclusive acquire livelocked under host scheduling and caused 80-170 ms hitches.
Removes the job queue's other acquire's exclusive store; the atomic swap already claimed the lock. The spin caused 80-170 ms hitches.
Removes the other job-queue exclusive-store retry. The acquire is one atomic swap; the old spin caused 80-170 ms hitches under host scheduling.
During events, always take the ordinary CPU frame measurement instead of the in-event path. Measuring the GPU span stretched presents by about 33 ms.
During events, do not replace the frame span with the max of CPU and GPU time. That GPU span stretched presents by about 33 ms once timestamps were real.
Layout animation steps from the measured frame ratio instead of the integer present interval, so menus and the HUD do not run twice as fast at 120 fps.
Drops the layout animation's conversion of the integer interval to float. The step is already the measured frame ratio.
Drops the layout animation's multiply by one half. At 120 fps the integer interval stays 1, so the old step ran every animation twice as fast.
The fade timer steps from the measured frame ratio instead of the integer present interval, so fades do not run twice as fast at 120 fps.
Drops the fade timer's conversion of the integer interval to float. The step is already the measured frame ratio.
Drops the fade timer's multiply by one half. At 120 fps the integer interval stays 1, so the old step finished the fade twice as fast.

resolution.gpu_budget_note: At 120 fps, feed completed GPU work into the resolution controller while preserving elapsed counters; other rates retain the fixed scale.
